output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Klaviyo’s latest quarterly filing identifies Adobe, Salesforce, Mailchimp, and Braze as its main named competitors. Klaviyo classifies Mailchimp and Braze as marketing-solution providers, while Adobe and Salesforce are large, consolidated marketing-automation providers. Other platforms—including Omnisend, Iterable, HubSpot, Attentive, and Drip—may compete with Klaviyo in particular ecommerce, SMS, CRM, or enterprise use cases, but they are not included in Klaviyo’s latest explicit four-company list.
caveats: “Main competitors” is a company-defined label: Klaviyo’s latest filing explicitly names four companies, while competition can vary by customer segment and product use case.
The fiscal 2025 annual-report filing date was not verified to an exact day from the opened page; the latest quarterly filing dated November 4, 2026 is the stronger current source.
